questions.text: Which country is the Taj Mahal located in?
questions.funFact: The Taj Mahal was built between 1632 and 1653 by Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan.

questions.text: Where can you find the Machu Picchu ruins?
questions.funFact: Machu Picchu was built in the 15th century and was unknown to the outside world until 1911.

questions.text: Which country is the Great Wall located in?
questions.funFact: The Great Wall stretches over 21,000 km and was built over many centuries.

questions.text: The Colosseum is an iconic landmark of which city?
questions.funFact: The Colosseum could hold between 50,000 and 80,000 spectators.

questions.text: Angkor Wat is a famous temple complex in which country?
questions.funFact: Angkor Wat is the largest religious monument in the world.

questions.text: Which country does Samba music originate from?
questions.funFact: Samba originated in Rio's Afro-Brazilian communities in the early 20th century.

questions.text: Flamenco is a traditional art form from which country?
questions.funFact: Flamenco was inscribed as a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage in 2010.

questions.text: The sitar is a traditional instrument from which country?
questions.funFact: Ravi Shankar popularized the sitar worldwide through his collaborations with The Beatles.

questions.text: K-Pop music originates from which country?
questions.funFact: The global K-Pop industry is worth over $10 billion.

questions.text: Reggae music originated on which Caribbean island?
questions.funFact: Bob Marley is the most iconic reggae artist and a global cultural icon.

questions.text: Which country does sushi originally come from?
questions.funFact: The original sushi was fermented fish preserved in rice, quite different from modern sushi.

questions.text: Tacos are a traditional food from which country?
questions.funFact: Tacos have been a staple in Mexico since pre-Columbian times.

questions.text: Pad Thai is the national dish of which country?
questions.funFact: Pad Thai was promoted as a national dish in the 1930s to foster Thai identity.

questions.text: Couscous is a traditional dish from which region?
questions.funFact: The knowledge and practices around couscous were inscribed by UNESCO in 2020.

questions.text: Which country is the origin of croissants?
questions.funFact: Despite being associated with France, croissants were inspired by the Austrian Kipferl.
